title: 第3章 你很有钱？

content_zh:
如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    女孩子也不再踢林逸的腿了，而是靠在车窗边，静静的听着她的歌曲。
“前方到站松山站，请下车的乘客做好准备，本次停车，十五分钟。”
火车的广播里传来了到站的预告，林逸也开始收拾行李，准备下车了。
没想到的是，身边的女孩子也开始收拾起行李来，显然也是要在松山站下车。
当女孩子站起身时，林逸目测了一下，自己猜测的没错，女孩子的身高大概是一米六五左右。
下了火车，林逸很是惊叹的看着火车站里那些华丽的建筑。
虽然十年前曾经来过这里一次，但是十年后的今天，松山已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。
“等一下！”
一个甜美的女声在林逸的身后响起，林逸停下了脚步，下意识的回过头去。
是刚才火车上坐在自己身边的那个女孩子，正挥着手，快步的向自己跑来。
“有什么事么？”
林逸自然不会相信女孩子会一见钟情的看上自己，虽说自己长得挺帅的，但是这一身的行头实在是太土了。
土黄色的裤子白背心，和进城找工的农民工一个打扮。
“你不会是想着要去兑奖吧？”
女孩子有些恨恨的说道，她在生气，之前在火车上林逸为什么对她的提醒置若罔闻。
“哦，你说这个呀？”
林逸从口袋里将拉环掏了出来，随手扔在了路边。
“啊？！”
这回轮到女孩子傻眼了！
她怎么也没想到，林逸会做出这么一个举动出来！

“你……你给扔了？”
女孩子惊讶的指着林逸，张大了嘴巴。
“恩，扔了。”
林逸点了点头：“本来就是假的，留着也没用。”
“你知道是假的？”
女孩子听了林逸的话，顿时有些转不过弯来了，傻傻的看着林逸。
这人到底怎么回事儿呀？
明知道是假的，还花钱买来？
是不是神经病呀？
看他的样子，也不像是那种恶趣味的有钱人啊。
“知道。就算我不知道，在火车上你还提醒我来着呢！”
林逸笑了笑说道。
“那你还把钱给他们？”
女孩子顿时急了，这什么人呀？
林逸笑了笑，将自己的背包从肩上拿了下来，拉开拉链，然后敞开在了女孩子的面前。
女孩子诧异的看了林逸一眼，然后低下头去，向林逸的背包里看去，顿时吓了一跳！
里面居然有七八捆钞票！
“你很有钱？有钱也不能乱花呀？”
女孩子没太明白林逸的意思，以为林逸这么做是在显示他自己有多么的有钱。
“这就是刚才的钱。”

林逸说道。
“刚才的钱？什么意思？”
女孩子没听明白：“你是说你把钱又拿回来了？不是只有四万九么，这都有七八万了吧？”
“那个眼镜男手里还有三万，被我一块儿拿过来了。”
林逸耸了耸肩说道。
这只是小意思，举手之劳而已，对于林逸来说，再简单不过了。
“嗄？”
女孩子这回彻底的傻了！不是林逸有毛病，而是人家技高一筹，不但拿回了自己的钱，连眼镜男的钱也给顺了过来！
“怎么这个表情？不会是想去举报我偷窃吧？你的正义感蛮强的。”
林逸看着女孩子吃惊的表情，笑了笑调侃道。
“当然不会。”
女孩子脸色一红，摇了摇头。
“不过之前真的谢谢你，像你这样的女孩子不多了。”
林逸由衷的说道：“一会儿请你吃个饭？”
“不了……”
女孩子扭捏的摇了摇头：“我家人在出站口等我呢。”
林逸听后点了点头也没强求，泡妞这东西，是个技术活，但是也要讲求随缘，太刻意就适得其反了：“那就不打扰了。”
王心妍望着林逸远去的背影，摇了摇头，这真是个很奇特的人呢，要不是妈妈就在出站口等着自己，王心妍也不介意和林逸多接触一下。
倒不是说王心妍对林逸有什么好感，只是觉得，林逸实在是有些与众不同！
在背包里装那么多的钱，也不存银行，穿着土的不能再土了，却有一种说不出的气质来。

“先生，住不住店？很便宜的……”
林逸一出了火车站，就被一群附近旅店拉客的人给围住了。
这种民工似的打扮，是这些小旅店做生意重点关注的对象。
有钱人谁住这种小旅店啊，大宾馆也用不着出来拉客。
林逸摆了摆手，挤过了这几个揽客的人的包围圈，向广场上的出租车停靠点儿走去，林逸手里拿着一张纸条，是临出门前，老头子给他的地址。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. The girl no longer kicked Lin Yi's legs, but leaned against the car window and listened to her songs quietly.
"The station ahead is Songshan Station. Passengers getting off the train, please be prepared. This stop will take fifteen minutes."
The arrival notice came over the train's announcement, and Lin Yi started to pack his luggage and prepare to get off.
Unexpectedly, the girls next to me also started to pack their luggage, and they were obviously going to get off at Songshan Station.
When the girl stood up, Lin Yi made a visual inspection and found that his guess was correct. The girl's height was about 1.65 meters.
After getting off the train, Lin Yi looked at the gorgeous buildings in the train station in amazement.
Although I had been here once ten years ago, today, ten years later, Songshan has undergone earth-shaking changes.
"Wait a minute!"
A sweet female voice sounded behind Lin Yi. Lin Yi stopped and turned around subconsciously.
It was the girl who was sitting next to me on the train just now, waving her hands and running towards me quickly.
"What's the matter?"
Lin Yi naturally wouldn't believe that a girl would fall in love with him at first sight. Although he was quite handsome, his outfit was too tacky.
In khaki pants and a white vest, he is dressed like a migrant worker looking for work in the city.
"You're not thinking about redeeming your prize, are you?"
The girl said bitterly. She was angry about why Lin Yi ignored her reminder on the train.
"Oh, are you talking about this?"
Lin Yi took the ring out of his pocket and threw it on the roadside.
"Ah?!"
This time it was the girl's turn to be dumbfounded!
She never expected that Lin Yi would make such a move!
"You...you threw it away?"
The girl pointed at Lin Yi in surprise and opened her mouth wide.
"Well, throw it away."
Lin Yi nodded: "It's a fake in the first place, and it's useless to keep it."
"You know it's fake?"
After hearing Lin Yi's words, the girl suddenly couldn't turn around and looked at Lin Yi stupidly.
What's going on with this guy?
You know it's fake, but you still spend money to buy it?
Is it crazy?
From the look of him, he doesn't look like a rich man with bad taste.
"I know. Even if I didn't know, you still reminded me on the train!"
Lin Yi smiled and said.
"Then you still give them the money?"
The girl suddenly became anxious, who is this?
Lin Yi smiled, took his backpack off his shoulders, unzipped it, and opened it in front of the girl.
The girl glanced at Lin Yi in surprise, then lowered her head and looked into Lin Yi's backpack, and was immediately startled!
There were actually seven or eight bundles of banknotes inside!
"Are you very rich? Even if you have money, you can't spend it carelessly?"
The girl didn't quite understand what Lin Yi meant, thinking that Lin Yi was doing this to show how rich he was.
"This is the money just now."
Lin Yi said.
"Money just now? What do you mean?"
The girl didn't understand: "You mean you got the money back? Isn't it only 49,000? It's already 70,000 or 80,000, right?"
"The man with glasses still had thirty thousand in his hand, and I took them all together."
Lin Yi shrugged and said.
This is just a trivial matter, just a little effort. For Lin Yi, it couldn't be easier.
"Huh?"
The girl was completely stupid this time! It wasn't that Lin Yi was at fault, but that he was superior. Not only did he get his own money back, but he also got the money from the man with glasses!
"Why this expression? You don't want to report me for stealing, do you? You have a very strong sense of justice."
Lin Yi looked at the girl's surprised expression, smiled and teased.
"Of course not."
The girl blushed and shook her head.
"But before that I really thank you, a girl like youNot much more. "
Lin Yi said sincerely: "I'll treat you to a meal later? "
"No..."
The girl shook her head nervously: "My family is waiting for me at the exit. "
Lin Yi nodded after hearing this and didn't force it. Picking up girls is a technical job, but you also have to be casual. Being too deliberate will be counterproductive: "Then I won't bother you. "
Wang Xinyan looked at Lin Yi's retreating back and shook her head. He was really a very strange person. If her mother hadn't been waiting for her at the exit, Wang Xinyan wouldn't have minded having more contact with Lin Yi.
It's not that Wang Xinyan has a good impression of Lin Yi, but she just thinks that Lin Yi is a little different!
He carries so much money in his backpack and doesn't save it in the bank. His clothes can't be more tacky, but he has an indescribable aura.
“Sir, can’t you stay in a hotel? Very cheap…”
As soon as Lin Yi left the train station, he was surrounded by a group of people soliciting customers from a nearby hotel.
Dressing like migrant workers is what these small hotels focus on when doing business.
Who among the rich would stay in a small hotel like this? There is no need for a big hotel to solicit customers.
Lin Yi waved his hand, squeezed through the circle of people soliciting customers, and walked towards the taxi stop in the square. Lin Yi held a piece of paper in his hand, which was the address the old man gave him before going out.
